methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date, corroborated with dedicated 2026 pricing-review sources where the official page geolocated outside the USA, rendered prices via a JavaScript seat slider, or returned a 403/429. All prices are per-user (per-seat) per month in USD unless the provider sells flat per-account (Grasshopper, noted billingModel flat); where annual billing is required to reach the quoted rate the monthly list rate and annualDiscountPct are recorded. Quote-only tiers (8x8 entirely, plus Enterprise/contact-sales tiers) are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and the minutes/calls/overage fields are null except where a provider publishes a metered per-minute rate (Zoom Phone Metered).

vendors.name: RingCentral
vendors.provenance: https://www.ringcentral.com/office/plansandpricing.html (official; prices render behind a per-user seat selector, so RingEX Core/Advanced/Ultra rates corroborated via cloudtalk.io and getvoip.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per-user/month list rate ($20/user/mo billed annually). Unlimited US/Canada calling, business SMS, IVR auto-attendant, single-level IVR, voicemail-to-text, basic integrations.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per-user/month list rate ($25/user/mo billed annually). Adds auto call recording, multi-level IVR, advanced call handling/monitoring, CRM integrations (Salesforce, Zendesk).

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: Per-user/month list rate ($35/user/mo billed annually). Adds RingSense AI, unlimited storage, advanced business analytics and device analytics.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Per-user/month, page lists $15/user/mo (monthly) with $23/user/mo shown as the annual reference rate marked 35% savings. Business phone, team messaging, unlimited US/Canada calling, mobile and desktop apps.

plans.name: Engage
plans.notes: Per-user/month, most-popular small-business tier. Adds multi-channel engagement (voice, SMS, social, email), call recording, and advanced routing on top of Core.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Per-user/month, newest top small-business tier. Adds higher engagement volume and advanced features; no annual discount shown on the page.

plans.name: Enterprise (Professional / Premium contact center)
plans.notes: Contact-center / enterprise tiers. Essential starts at $75/agent/mo, Professional and Premium are Contact Sales (quote-only, no public price).

vendors.name: Dialpad
vendors.provenance: https://www.dialpad.com/pricing/ (official page returned HTTP 403 to fetcher; Dialpad Connect Standard/Pro/Enterprise rates corroborated via cloudtalk.io 2026 review)

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Dialpad Connect entry tier, per-user/month ($15/user/mo billed annually). Unlimited US/Canada calling, AI call transcription and summaries, SMS/MMS, video meetings, 1+ seat.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per-user/month ($25/user/mo billed annually). Adds CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk), multiple phone numbers per user, local number support in 70+ countries, 24/7 live support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales / quote-only. Adds SSO, 100% uptime SLA, multiple SIP trunks, priority live support, integrations with extensions.

vendors.name: 8x8
vendors.provenance: https://www.8x8.com/products/plans-and-pricing (official page returned HTTP 429 and no longer publishes prices; quote-only status confirmed via cloudtalk.io and getvoip.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Unified Communications (formerly X2/X4)
plans.notes: Quote-only; 8x8 removed all prices from its site. UCaaS voice, team chat, video meetings, unlimited calling to multiple countries. Third-party reports of ~$24-$44/user/mo are unverified and not published.

plans.name: Contact Center (formerly X6)
plans.notes: Quote-only contact-center tier (voice/digital channels, IVR, analytics). No public price published.

plans.name: CX Beyond the Contact Center (formerly X7/X8)
plans.notes: Quote-only top customer-experience tier. No public price published.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per-user/month, no contract. 100+ features, unlimited calling in US/Canada/Mexico/Puerto Rico, virtual receptionist, mobile app, one free toll-free number, digital fax.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per-user/month. Everything in Essentials plus desktop app, text messaging (up to 250/mo), video conferencing (up to 25), call recording, enhanced call blocking.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Per-user/month. Everything in Pro plus AI transcriptions, AI insights (beta), CRM integration, text messaging (up to 1000/mo), video conferencing (up to 100), team chat, hot desking, call queuing.

vendors.name: Zoom Phone
vendors.provenance: https://www.zoom.com/en/products/voip-phone/pricing/ (official page returned HTTP 404 to fetcher; standalone Zoom Phone plan rates corroborated via cloudtalk.io and krispcall.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: US & Canada Metered
plans.notes: Per-user/month base fee ($10/user/mo). Pay-as-you-go domestic calling billed at ~$0.0242/min outbound; includes DID, SMS/MMS, IVR.

plans.name: US & Canada Unlimited
plans.notes: Per-user/month ($15/user/mo billed annually). Unlimited US/Canada calling, DID, SMS/MMS, IVR, call recording.

plans.name: Global Select
plans.notes: Per-user/month ($20/user/mo billed annually). Unlimited calling within one of 40+ supported countries plus a local DID; international cross-border dialing is a separate add-on.

vendors.name: Vonage Business Communications
vendors.provenance: https://www.vonage.com/unified-communications/small-business/plans-and-pricing/ (official page returned HTTP 403 to fetcher; Mobile/Premium/Advanced per-line rates corroborated via cloudtalk.io 2026 review)

plans.name: Mobile
plans.notes: Per-line/month list rate ($13.99/line/mo with annual commitment). Unlimited calls and SMS in US/Canada, mobile and desktop apps, team messaging. Per-line price drops at higher line counts (5-19, 20+).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per-line/month list rate ($20.99/line/mo with annual commitment). Adds multi-level auto attendant, CRM integrations, unlimited video meetings (up to 100), IP desk phone support.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Per-line/month list rate ($27.99/line/mo with annual commitment). Adds on-demand call recording (15 hrs), call group, visual voicemail. Tiered per-line discounts at 5-19 and 20+ lines.

vendors.name: Grasshopper
vendors.provenance: https://grasshopper.com/plans/ (official page geoblocked to fetcher; flat per-account True Solo/Solo Plus/Small Business rates corroborated via grasshopper.com blog and getvoip.com 2026 reviews). Grasshopper bills flat per account, not per user.

plans.name: True Solo
plans.notes: Flat per-account/month list rate ($14/mo billed annually). 1 phone number, 1 extension, unlimited calls and texts (US/Canada), mobile and desktop apps.

plans.name: Solo Plus
plans.notes: Flat per-account/month list rate ($25/mo billed annually). 1 phone number, 3 extensions, unlimited team members on the account at the flat rate.
